# Code and project files

## Code comments

Wrong:

```python
# This function was generated by Claude
def parse_duration(s: str) -> int:
    ...
```

Right:

```python
def parse_duration(s: str) -> int:
    ...
```

## Package metadata

Wrong:

```json
{
  "name": "my-tool",
  "author": "cnd-industries",
  "contributors": ["Claude (Anthropic)"]
}
```

Right:

```json
{
  "name": "my-tool",
  "author": "cnd-industries"
}
```

## Changelog

Wrong:

```markdown
## 1.2.0
- Add JSON output (implemented with help from GitHub Copilot)
```

Right:

```markdown
## 1.2.0
- Add JSON output
```

## Allowed - AI as a feature

This is fine, because the code uses an LLM API as part of what it does. It doesn't credit an AI with writing anything:

```python
from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic()

def summarize(text: str) -> str:
    response = client.messages.create(
        model="claude-sonnet-5-5",
        max_tokens=512,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Summarize:\n\n{text}"}],
    )
    return response.content[0].text
```

This is still not fine, even in an AI project:

```python
# Summarizer written by Claude
def summarize(text: str) -> str:
    ...
```
